notes.key_messages:
To maximise their chances of success on this paper, candidates should:
• ensure that all questions are answered,
• make any alterations to an answer unambiguous,
• tick no more than two sentences as Vrai in Section 3,
• ensure that the wording of answers follows logically from the question,
• avoid trying to include too much information.
notes.general_comments:
The majority of candidates dealt confidently with the variety of reading comprehension exercise types on this
paper. The paper offered an appropriate challenge and gradient of difficulty and a range of performance was
observed. Standards of legibility and presentation were generally good. All candidates appeared to have
ample time to complete the paper.
